UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated investor profile for IPO One storing Google identity and verified mobile contact preferences.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Email address associated with the Google account.

mobileNumber.description: Mobile number (+91 format) registered for UPI mandate alerts.

investorCategory.description: Preferred investor category (RETAIL, sNII, bNII, EMPLOYEE).

syncedDematCount.description: Count of active family Demat accounts managed locally.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: Cloud-synced IPO watchlist entry and allotment probability target for an authenticated user.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

ipoSymbol.description: NSE/BSE ticker symbol of the IPO.

targetLots.description: Planned number of lots to apply across family Demat accounts.

notes.description: User strategy note for the IPO.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores per-user investor profile and mobile preferences isolated by userId.

/users/{userId}/ipo_watchlists/{watchlis.description: Stores per-user cloud-synced IPO watchlist and strategy items.
